# Copilot project instructions

Follow the repository-wide rules in [`AGENTS.md`](../AGENTS.md) for all DSB-Bot work. That file is the canonical source for product scope, schedule-priority rules, DSB evidence requirements, security, and approval boundaries.

Before changing code, inspect the current implementation and relevant tests. Preserve the existing, substantially implemented GitHub Pages frontend: work on it means integrating its existing views with the backend API, not rebuilding it. Keep the README and [`ROADMAP.md`](../ROADMAP.md) aligned with the actual repository state.

Do not treat the historical files under `agent-docs/` as current implementation status. They contain reference snapshots and design history and are intentionally excluded from source control.
